Class IntellijHandle

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.resource.handle.AbstractResourceHandle
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.resources.handle.IntellijHandle
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.openapi.vfs.VirtualFileListener, EventListener, ResourceHandle, Rebindable
public class IntellijHandle extends AbstractResourceHandle implements com.intellij.openapi.vfs.VirtualFileListener, Rebindable
An IntelliJ-native reactive resource handle that wraps physical and virtual files.

This handle integrates with the IntelliJ Virtual File System (VFS), listening for file renames, movements, content modifications, and deletions. When a file is moved across packages/folders or renamed, it updates its managed path and URI and marks the parent Resource dirty so the AI context reflects the change without requiring manual re-adding.

anahata

    • getHtmlDisplayName

      public String getHtmlDisplayName()
      Returns an optional HTML-formatted display name. Used by IDE environments to show status (e.g. Git colors).

      Resolves the Version Control System (VCS) status from IntelliJ's FileStatusManager and wraps the file name in HTML font tags matching the active IDE color scheme (e.g. blue for modified, green for added, grey for ignored). Returns null if the file has not been modified so standard plain text rendering is used.

      Specified by:
      getHtmlDisplayName in interface ResourceHandle
      Returns:
      The HTML display name, or null.

    • isModified

      public boolean isModified()
      Checks whether the underlying resource has unsaved in-memory modifications in the active host environment (e.g., an open NetBeans/IntelliJ editor tab).

      Queries IntelliJ's FileDocumentManager to determine whether this file currently has unsaved in-memory modifications in an open editor tab.

      Specified by:
      isModified in interface ResourceHandle
      Returns:
      true if the resource has unsaved modifications in memory, false otherwise.
